coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, transverse jaw across X, tail+Y, up+Z; neutral swimming pose.

concept.reason: Primary skull photos and diagrams inspected; diagnostic form established, no generated concept.

scope: Original whole organism with hammer-shaped broad muzzle and dense filtering dentition, not skull-only or generic marine reptile.
specimen_basis: IVPP V20291 dorsal skull and V20292 ventral skull, actual photos/interpretations Fig1–2 in Li et al.2016. Body follows paper postcranial description; living surface and pose inferred, not copied paleoart.

scale.basis: Approximate genus-sized artistic target from indexed IVPP/CAS author news; direct news page timed out, not a measured V20291 length. Primary skull photos carry2cm bars.

diagnostic_targets: Wide transverse anterior jaw creates a T-shaped hammer muzzle; both upper and lower jaws expand laterally. Eyes remain on skull behind muzzle, not at hammer ends like shark.
Front edge uses short chisel/peg-like teeth; posterior jaw sides use dense finer needle mesh. Slight gape exposes this distinction without giant predator fangs.
Heavy elongate trunk, moderately extended neck, large robust forelimbs, complete hindlimbs and long tapering tail; restrained low dorsal contour.
Whole aquatic reptile body, four limb pairs NOT permitted: exactly four limbs total. Do not add shark fins, turtle shell or whale flukes.
uncertainties: Colour, soft tissue, webbing and detailed limb/tail profile are reconstruction choices.
Dentition count deliberately reduced for lowpoly readability, not claimed exact count.
2014 downturned zipper-mouth reconstruction is superseded by2016 hammerhead evidence; do not copy it.
acceptance_checks: Top/front clearly shows T-shaped transverse jaw; no drooping vertical zipper or shark-eye placement.
Front short teeth and side fine teeth remain readable as different functional zones; all rooted, no detached spikes.
Head remains small relative to stout trunk; do not exaggerate to toy hammerhead monster.
Four default views only; perspective may reuse preview; original meshes/materials, no copied fossil texture or artwork.
handoff_contract: Same localdir prep/maker/QA; maker sends fixedhash COMPLETE and stops. Root asynchronous backup, keep local for integration. No PR/upload/cleanup by production task.
